units.text: The main principles for developing transport infrastructure facilities are:

units.text: meeting demand for transport infrastructure by planning and prioritizing transport projects according to their socioeconomic effects on the basis of the transport and economic balance of the Russian Federation;

units.text: ensuring transport connectivity of anchor settlements. Transport connectivity of urban agglomerations and administrative centers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation outside urban agglomerations, as well as anchor settlements that ensure the national security of the Russian Federation and serve critical infrastructure, is provided mainly by facilities of the unified core transport network, including roads forming part of it. Transport connectivity of other anchor settlements, including with settlements in adjacent territories, and of remote settlements with anchor settlements, is provided through regional and local roads, including their development and upgrading to regulatory standards, and through improved transport services for residents of those territories; where road connectivity cannot be ensured, other modes of transport are used;
